reflectionQuestion: Can you think of a time when you felt really small but then something helped you feel brave and strong?
title: Little Seed, Big Rain, Beautiful Growth
theme: a tiny seed who is afraid it is too small until the rain comes and it grows
reflectionText: Sometimes the smallest things hold the biggest surprises inside. A little seed sits quietly in the dark dirt, wondering if anything will ever happen. Then the rain comes, soft and steady. Drop by drop, something begins to change. A tiny green shoot pushes up toward the sunlight. That small seed was never too small at all. It just needed time and a little help from the rain. Growing happens like that sometimes — slowly, quietly, when nobody is even watching. Every flower in every garden started out just as tiny. And every kid was once very, very small too.
